name: @hobo/provider-ttl-sh
description: HoBo ttl-sh.ephemeral-oci-artifact/v1 transport: an adjacent, anonymous OCI artifact transport with generated collision-resistant repository names, an explicit bounded TTL encoded in the tag, digest-pinned references, a none-expire lifecycle warning, and promotion into an owner-controlled registry. Hosts nothing, claims nothing, and refuses durable state by construction.
